behavior: AC1 — the registry accepts a retired field and refuses blank names, login fields, a field a declaration reads, duplicates, and a field on an item retired whole
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestRegistryValidatesRetiredItems$|^TestRegistryValidatesRetiredFields$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 2

behavior: AC2 — a retired field is planned last with its reason and what the item keeps, reported gone when absent, blocked when ambiguous, and removed on apply
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestPlanRetiredFields$|^TestApplyDeletesARetiredField$|^TestReconcileDeletesARetiredField$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 3

behavior: AC3 — bw.from is accepted on a multi-var secret over one field and plans one operation; refused when the fields differ
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestBWFromOnAMultiVarSecret$|^TestPlanMultiVarFromPlansOnce$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 2

behavior: AC4 — sync ci uploads a name given twice only once
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestScopeUploadDedupesNames$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 1

behavior: AC5 — no planted value reaches the plan or apply output on the delete-field path
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestPlanRetiredFields$|^TestReconcileDeletesARetiredField$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 2
